World Cup

By Kiki · Pilot release for PolyTrack 0.6.3

Run an eight-player live cup from the organizer's multiplayer game: two sequential semifinals, then a grand final. Reach the points target and win a later round to qualify.

  • Native invite-code joining, seed selection, and captain picks.
  • Choose 3–5 official, community, or locally saved custom tracks; racers pick their order in seed order.
  • Racer names include their actual car-skin previews.
  • Automatic scoring, finalist rules, round countdowns, warmups, and track rotation.
  • Spectators follow a racer's actual driving-camera pose and can switch competitors.
  • Organizer controls for disconnects, voiding rounds, undo, saves, and results export.

After enabling the mod and reloading, press F8. Everyone in the event needs the same version. Set the native room capacity to 16; that limit includes racers and spectators. No separate tournament server is needed.

This pilot has been tested in three local game instances. Eight-computer Internet performance is still unverified. The host scores client-reported finishes; there is no independent anti-cheat verification. See the repository README for full rules and setup.

A community competition mod inspired by the 2024 format. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Trackmania, Ubisoft, Kodub, or PolyModLoader.
